preconditions.name: world_model_converged_frozen_probe

preconditions.description: on the converged frozen base, PE rises under a max-novelty shock (readiness R1) -- the instrument can move at all
preconditions.control: SHOCK_DRIFT positive control vs STABLE_DRIFT, ready seeds

preconditions.name: learnability_bins_populated

preconditions.control: min 5 samples in bin[0-2] and bin[13+] on ARM_3_HIGH and ARM_4_NOISE

preconditions.name: noise_control_at_least_as_elevated

preconditions.control: ARM_4_NOISE mel vs ARM_3_HIGH mel, all seeds
